data.animaCaption: Caught on tiptoe while pulling a heavy volume from the upper shelf, she freezes with one hand on the book spine and glances through the narrow aisle gap in flustered surprise. Bright window light pours down the corridor between the tall oak bookcases.
data.promptProse: Framed through the vertical slot between two dark oak bookshelves in the foreground, Ayachi Nene stands on tiptoe in a sunlit library aisle wearing her Himematsu navy blazer and grey plaid skirt. Her right hand stretches upward to slide a clothbound book off a high shelf while her left steadies two notebooks against her waist; startled by the viewer's approach, she turns her head with wide purple eyes and a sudden pink blush. Clear afternoon sunlight streams from a tall window at the end of the corridor, brightening the polished floor and outlining her silver hair against the shadowed stacks.
data.story: 图书室深处的木书架隔开了走廊喧闹。你绕过拐角，正好撞见踮着脚够顶层文献的宁宁；听见动静她指尖一顿，抱着书惊慌回头，眼底很快又化开轻柔笑意——「呀、吓我一跳……那个，能不能帮我把这本拿下来？」
